text:
rafa: LarkBridge (LB-210) invoice INV-2026-212 for $9,120 is overdue. Sent dunning 1979996000; customer replied asking for 30-day deferral citing delayed PO.
marta: Can we allow a deferral? Any signs of abuse or repeated late payments?
rafa: Their payment history shows two late pays in last year but current ARR small. They offered to sign an agreement and provide PO within 72h.
tony: I'd accept a 30-day deferral but add a 1% admin fee and require ACH/PO before deferral starts. Also add clause: if PO not received in 72h we resume collections.
marta: Agree. Add a clause that acceptance doesn't waive our right to collections if they misrepresent the PO.
acct-rep: Customer confirmed they'll submit PO and wire info within 48h. Asking for email copy of terms.
rafa: Draft msg to send:

"We can approve a 30-day deferral for INV-2026-212. Total due $9,211.20 (1% admin fee added). Payment due in full 30 days. This offer requires: (1) signed deferral agreement, (2) PO or ACH setup within 72 hours, and (3) acceptance within 72 hours. Failure to provide PO will result in escalation to collections."

marta: Send it, cc Legal and Sales.

collections-bot: reminder email sent to LarkBridge at 1979990900.
